title.narrative: Provision of humanitarian supplies to support critical lifesaving integrated SRH and GBV emergency services to crisis affected populations in Amhara region and Contested areas in the Northern Ethiopia

description.narrative: UNFPA in partnership with sectoral government offices such as Women and Social Affairs Bureau and Health Bureau and UNFPA GBV implementing partners that have presence in Amhara region (South Gonder zone) and in the contested areas in Northern Ethiopia will target 113,600 women and girls who need lifesaving integrated Sexual reproductive health (SRH) and Gender-based violence (GBV) services in the target region and contested areas affected by crisis. Of the total 113,600 target beneficiaries, 93,600 are targeted for the provision of lifesaving integrated GBV and SRH services and the remaining 20, 000 for the provision of female dignity kits. The project will focus on the following two outputs:1. Lifesaving integrated SRH and GBV services are available and accessible to women and girls,2. Women and girls of reproductive age benefited with the provision of 20,000 dignity kits to address their hygiene and protection needs.In order to achieve results, UNFPA and its partners will equip health facilities with lifesaving interagency reproductive health Kits (IARH), undertake on site orientation on the proper utilization of the IARH kits and female dignity kits components, provide female dignity kits to most vulnerable women and girls of reproductive age group and conduct post distribution monitoring among dignity kits beneficiaries and GBV partners in the target project woredas.
